translationRepairs: [1] In the third month, on the new moon day yisi, famine in the Southern Metropolitan Region was relieved.
[1] In the third month, on the new moon day jisi, famine in the Southern Metropolitan Region was relieved.

The unit writes 三月已巳朔; 已 is not a heavenly stem, so the graph is the usual 己/已 confusion for 己巳 (jisi). Reading it as yisi invents 乙巳. The following 壬申 fits a new-moon 己巳 by three days, and the idiomatic already has jisi.

On jiyou the eunuch Zhang Shan took charge of military affairs; Marquis of Dingxi Jiang Wan became supreme commander and, with Grand Secretary Yu Zijun as overall director, readied the defenses of Datong and Xuanfu.

On jiyou the eunuch Zhang Shan took charge of military affairs; Marquis of Dingxi Jiang Wan became supreme commander and, with Governor-Minister Yu Zijun as overall director, readied the defenses of Datong and Xuanfu.
The Chinese titles Yu Zijun 同總督尚書余子俊: 總督尚書 is a governor-minister (shangshu), not a Grand Secretary (大學士). Governor-Minister restores the office correctly.

On the day jiyou, the eunuch Zhang Shan supervised military affairs; Marquis of Dingxi Jiang Wan served as supreme commander, together with Grand Secretary Yu Zijun as overall director, to prepare defenses at Datong and Xuanfu.

On the day jiyou, the eunuch Zhang Shan supervised military affairs; Marquis of Dingxi Jiang Wan served as supreme commander, together with Governor-Minister Yu Zijun as overall director, to prepare defenses at Datong and Xuanfu.
Same unit: 總督尚書 is governor-minister, not Grand Secretary; the literal must match that title.
On guimao an edict ruled that in extreme heat or bitter cold ministers might submit no more than five items at court.
On guiwei an edict ruled that in extreme heat or bitter cold ministers might submit no more than five items at court.
The day is 癸未 (guiwei), not 癸卯 (guimao). Preceding 六月辛巳 then 癸未 is two days later, confirming guiwei.
On the day guimao, an edict ordered that in extreme heat or bitter cold court ministers' memorials should not exceed five items.
On the day guiwei, an edict ordered that in extreme heat or bitter cold court ministers' memorials should not exceed five items.
Literal likewise misreads 癸未 as guimao; guiwei is the correct sexagenary reading.
That month Bianai of the Duoyan Three Guards entered Liaodong; the court let him pasture near the frontier and supplied him with grain and cloth.
That month the Duoyan Three Guards, fleeing Nahai, entered Liaodong; the court ordered them to pasture near the frontier and supplied them with grain and cloth.
朵顏三衞避那孩入遼東 makes the Three Guards the subject fleeing Nahai; Bianai invents a person from 避那孩, and the plural 令駐牧…給米布 matches them, not a singular him.
That month Bianai of the Duoyan Three Guards entered Liaodong; he was ordered to pasture near the border and was given rice and cloth.
That month the Duoyan Three Guards, fleeing Nahai, entered Liaodong; they were ordered to pasture near the border and were given rice and cloth.
Same mistranslation in the literal: 避那孩 is fleeing Nahai, and 朵顏三衛 is collective, not an individual Bianai.
